query:
CREATE TABLE `clients` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `fullName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `birthDate` date,
  `phone` varchar(32),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `clients_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `products_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `report_schedules` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `frequency` enum('daily','weekly','monthly') NOT NULL,
  `recipientEmail` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `active` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `lastSentAt` timestamp,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `report_schedules_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `sales` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `sellerId` int NOT NULL,
  `clientId` int,
  `productId` int,
  `clientName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `clientBirthDate` date,
  `clientPhone` varchar(32),
  `productName` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `saleDate` date NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `notes` text,
  `attachmentUrl` text,
  `attachmentKey` varchar(512),
  `attachmentMime` varchar(64),
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `sales_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `displayName` varchar(128);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `phone` varchar(32);
ALTER TABLE `users` ADD `active` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL;
